name: window-check-presses-interrupted
description: A drag that the host refuses with 1013 after an action of a person ended the synthetic gesture leaves no open press, so the cleanup sends no release.
reason: The case sends native pointer input and the interruption is an action of a person, so the replay cannot arrange it.

error.message: a person's move at (40, 40) in the window of the gesture ended the synthetic gesture of pointer main, whose press was released at (10, 20)
